finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 were re-protected, the vouchers they are owed were issued, and each passenger was notified once of their new booking. This comes from the worker's report only; I haven't verified it independently.

**Process**
- No change fees or fare differences were charged.
- The worker found no active bulletins, so the handbook applied as written.
- The request queue was not touched.

**New bookings** (all 2026-08-03 unless noted)

| Passenger | Booked on | Cabin |
|---|---|---|
| Chloe Park (R6103) | UA88, arrives 12:25 | Business |
| Iris Vance (R6109) | UA88, arrives 12:25 | Premium Economy (one-cabin upgrade) |
| Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (R6110, R6111, group G-7) | AA204, arrive 15:15 | Economy |
| Ben Okafor (R6102) | DL512, arrives 18:40 | Economy |
| Farid Haddad (R6106) | UA88, arrives 12:25 | Basic Economy |
| Lea Sorensen (R6112) | AA204, arrives 15:15 | Business (one-cabin upgrade) |
| Dev Mehta (R6104) | AA210, arrives 23:50, then AA1410 ORD to BOS on Aug 4, arrives 12:25 | Economy |
| Mo Farah (R6113) | AA210, arrives 23:50, then AA1410 ORD to BOS on Aug 4, arrives 12:25 | Economy |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108) | AA210, arrives 23:50 | Economy |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | AA206 on Aug 4, arrives 15:15 | Economy |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | AA206 on Aug 4, arrives 15:15 | Economy |
| Elena Fox (R6105) | AA204, arrives 15:15 | Basic Economy |

- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were each a gold or platinum passenger travelling alone. Their own cabin was full on a flight that gets them there sooner than any open option in their own cabin.
- **Group G-7:** Jun and Kofi were kept together in their own cabin with no upgrade. They were ranked at the higher tier of the two.
- **Dev and Mo:** Their original onward ORD to BOS connection was broken, so the onward leg was rebooked. The AA210 to AA1410 connection is valid because the onward flight leaves the next morning.

**Vouchers issued**
- **Ben:** 15000-cent compensation voucher. He arrives 5 hours late, and no hotel voucher applies because he arrives the same day.
- **Dev and Mo:** each get a 30000-cent compensation voucher and an 18000-cent hotel voucher.
- **Hugo:** 30000-cent compensation voucher. No hotel voucher applies because he arrives the same day.
- **Grace:** 24000-cent compensation voucher, capped at her fare, plus an 18000-cent hotel voucher.
- **Ana:** 30000-cent compensation voucher and an 18000-cent hotel voucher.
- **Chloe, Iris, Jun, Kofi, Farid, Lea and Elena:** nothing owed, because each arrives less than 3 hours after the original time.

**Flag for follow-up:** The system date is 2026-10-06, about two months after the 2026-08-03 flight. The worker saw no rule conflict and acted as instructed. If any of these passengers had already travelled or been handled another way, check for duplicate handling.
